BSC51-CP04.name: ［Artemis Chaser］Moonlaila Randog
BSC51-CP04.effect:
Flash - [Mani: "［Adept Producer］Artemis" & C3 or more, (Either Attack Step)]
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, pay one cost from the target to summon this card from the Hand.

[team: Grand Siesta]

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Manifests/Attacks)
You can return an opposing Spirit to the deckbottom. When you've done so, refresh a Spirit with [Mani] you control.

[LV2][LV3] (End of Your Attack Step)
You can +1 core to one of your Yellow "Artemis" Grandwalker Nexuses. When you've done so, after the step ends, additional Draw Step and Refresh Step occur once and only once.

BSC51-CP02.name: ［Cyber Future］Fongneena
BSC51-CP02.effect:
Flash - [Contract Advent: "Fongneena" & C1 or more, (Your Turn)]
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from the Hand onto your target Spirit.

[team: Absolutes]

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned/Advents)
You can put one core from the Void each to two "Fongneena" you control.

[During OC & During Advent] [LV1][LV2] (When Attacks)
(Once per Turn: Same Name) You can send the [Soul Core] from your Trash to any "Fongneena". Then, if you have five counters or more, this Spirit can refresh.

BSC51-CP05.name: ［Greatest Wind］Gail Fenique
BSC51-CP05.effect:
[teams: Double Vivid Absolutes]

(Once per Turn: Same Name) When your Cost 4 or more "Formulia" is summoned, you can summon this card from the Hand, without paying the cost.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
You can put two cores from the Void to any Spirits you control.

[LV2][LV3] Flash - (Your Attack Step)
By paying two costs, refresh a [Double Vivid] Spirit you control.

PB15-D07.name: ［Halloween Ghost］Rias Urovorun
PB15-D07.effect:
[teams: Pretty Animals Twilight Gothic]

[Mirage: Cost 3 ([Yellow Core])]
[During Set] (Your Attack Step)
When your Cost 6 or more "Riolu Tida"/"Rias Urovorun" is summoned, send two cores from any opposing Spirits to the Trash.

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
(Once per Turn: Same Name) Return a "Diva" family Spirit card from your Trash to the Hand, and when "Riolu Tida" is returned, send a core from any opposing Spirit to the Reserve.

PB15-D08.name: ［Halloween Mummy］Saclaire Metum
PB15-D08.effect:
This card/Spirit has every Team.

[Mirage: Cost 3 ([Yellow Core][Yellow Core])]
[During Set]
Once per step, when your “Stage Style”/“Grand Style” family Spirit is summoned/[advents], +1 core to any "Producer" Grandwalker Nexus you control.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
Return a “Diva” family Spirit card from your Trash to the decktop.

PB15-D10.name: ［Halloween Specter］Banri-Zell
PB15-D10.effect:
This card/Spirit has every Team.

[Mirage: Cost 3 ([Yellow Core][Yellow Core])]
[During Set]
After your "Diva" family Burst activates, destroy an opposing 10000 BP or less Spirit. Then, once per turn, you can set a Burst card from your Hand.

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
(Once per Turn: Same Name) You can immediately activate one of your set "Diva" family Bursts. After that Burst activates, draw a card.

BSC51-CP01.name: ［Monochrome Fantasia］Rei-Ohba
BSC51-CP01.effect:
Flash - [Ultra Contract Advent: "［Together Forever］Rei-Ohba" & C6 or more, (Your Turn)]
(Once per Turn: Same Name) By stacking this card from your Hand onto its target, including those that are in Soul State/pre-advent condition, send your [Soul Core] to this Spirit.

[teams: Shiny Hearts Sacred Swords]

[During OC & During Advent] [LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Advents/Attacks)
You can destroy an opposing Spirit with a BP equal or inferior to this Spirit's. This effect can't be prevented by opposing effects.

[During OC & During Advent] [LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
You can summon a Brave card from your Hand, without paying the cost. Then, for each Brave you control, send an opposing Life to the Reserve. (Max. 2)

BSC51-CP03.name: ［Sengoku Witch Quartet］Flamme Sandria
BSC51-CP03.effect:
[team: Twilight Gothic]

(Once per Turn: Same Name) While this card is in the Trash, when your "［Together Forever］Flamme Sandria" is summoned, if you have three counters or more, you can return it to the Hand. Or, you can set it.

[Burst: After your Life is reduced]
Summon this card without paying the cost.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
You can destroy every opposing 10000 BP or less Spirit, and draw a card for each target destroyed.

BSC51-CP06.name: ［Together Forever］Blackster
BSC51-CP06.effect:
[team: Legendoll]

While this card is in Soul State, you can [Contract Advent] onto it. When you do, you can put any number of cores from your Field/Reserve to the advent card.

[Contract Pre-Advent]/[Spirit] [LV1][LV2]
Once per turn, when your "Diva" family Spirit attacks, you can return from your Trash to the Hand a Cost 7 or more Spirit card with the same team as that target.

[Contract Pre-Advent]/[Spirit] [LV1][LV2] (When Attacks)
Your counter +1. Then, you can target and attack an opposing LV1 Spirit.
